intro: Balir Frosthammer is a dwarven defender stationed in Coldridge Valley within Dun Morogh. Alarmed by the sudden and aggressive incursions of Rockjaw troggs into dwarven lands, he recruits fledgling adventurers to stem the tide before the valley is overrun.

p: Perched in the snowy enclave of Coldridge Valley, Balir Frosthammer watches the perimeter against encroaching dangers. The valley has long served as a safe haven and training ground for dwarven and gnomish novices, but recent disturbances underground have unleashed violent Rockjaw troggs onto the surface. Balir is among the first to sound the alarm, rallying newly arrived recruits to cull the troggs before they breach deeper into Dun Morogh.

Bearing the proud Frosthammer surname, Balir may share a lineage with Tannok Frosthammer of Kharanos. Their family stands resolute in their duty to Ironforge, ensuring that the cold mountain passes remain secure for travelers, miners, and mountaineers even as regional threats multiply.
